h1: Hyderabad SEO, while the keywords are still cheap
metaTitle: SEO Agency in Hyderabad: Pharma, SaaS, Real Estate
metaDescription: Hyderabad's commercial keywords are less contested than Bangalore's. We work with Genome Valley pharma, HITEC City SaaS and realty on a 90-day guarantee.
answer: Hyderabad's commercial search results are less contested than Bangalore's or Mumbai's in the same categories, because fewer local firms publish serious content. That shortens time-to-first-movement for pharma, realty and local services. It does nothing for HITEC City SaaS companies, who compete against American sites, not Hyderabadi ones. Our SEO starts at ₹75,000/mo.
takeaways: The softness is real but **category-specific**. Local intent is soft. Global intent is exactly as hard here as anywhere.
Genome Valley buyers search **molecule names, capabilities and certifications** — not "best CRO in India".
Hyderabad real estate keywords have a shelf life. A project name is worth ranking for during launch and pre-launch, and close to nothing 18 months later.
Telugu-script queries are a minority of Hyderabad search. **Transliterated Telugu and Hinglish are not.**
A 90-day baseline window is a fair bet in the soft categories. In SaaS we'll say so before you sign, not after.

sections.h2: Why Hyderabad results are softer than Bangalore's — and exactly where they aren't
body: Here's the honest version of the pitch. Search difficulty isn't a property of a keyword — it's a property of whoever is already ranking for it. Fewer Hyderabad businesses run a funded, continuous SEO programme than in Bangalore or Mumbai, so fewer optimised pages sit on page one, and a well-built page climbs faster.

That's a pattern we see in SERPs, not a published statistic. Nobody runs a credible city-by-city keyword difficulty survey for India, and any agency quoting you one is quoting a tool's guess dressed up as a fact.
The caveat matters: this only holds where your competitors are also Hyderabadi. The moment your buyer is in Ohio, so is your competitor.

sections.h2: Genome Valley: search behaviour nobody writes marketing copy for
body: Hyderabad anchors India's bulk drug and formulations industry, and Genome Valley in Medchal–Malkajgiri is the country's oldest organised life-sciences R&D cluster. Dr. Reddy's, Aurobindo, Divi's, Hetero, MSN, Laurus and Bharat Biotech are all built out here. Around them sits a far larger layer of CROs, CDMOs, analytical labs and excipient suppliers, and that layer is where the searchable demand lives.

The mistake almost every agency makes on a Genome Valley account is writing for the CEO instead of the buyer. A procurement lead at a mid-size formulator does not search "best CRO in India". They search a molecule, a dosage form, a capability, a certification, or all four at once.
That keyword universe barely shows up in a standard tool export, because the monthly volumes sit in single or double digits.
bullets: **Capability plus dosage form** — lyophilised injectable CDMO, nasal spray contract manufacturing, oral solid dosage pilot batch.
**Certification and regulatory status** — USFDA approved API manufacturer, EU GMP certified facility, WHO-GMP, CEP holder, DMF filed.
**Molecule and intermediate names**, including the ones your sales team spells three different ways.
**Analytical and stability services** — method validation, ICH stability chamber, elemental impurities testing per ICH Q3D.
**Comparison and shortlist queries** — CDMO vs CMO, what to ask a contract manufacturer, audit checklist.

callout.title: Low volume is the point
callout.body: A keyword with 20 searches a month, where 3 of those searchers run a ₹4 crore tender, is worth more than a 20,000-volume head term. We build pharma keyword sets from your own sales conversations first and the tools second.

sections.h2: HITEC City and Gachibowli: your competitor isn't in Kondapur
body: Madhapur, HITEC City, Gachibowli and the Financial District hold one of India's densest concentrations of software engineering. Microsoft's largest R&D centre outside the United States sits here, alongside Amazon, Google, Qualcomm, ServiceNow, Salesforce and a growing set of Indian product companies building for global buyers.

If you're one of those product companies, none of what we said about soft Hyderabad SERPs applies to you. Your buyer is a RevOps manager in Chicago. The pages outranking you belong to companies with eight years of content and a few thousand referring domains. Geography gives you nothing.

What we'd do instead is the standard [SaaS SEO](/seo-for/saas) play, run properly: own the bottom of the funnel first — alternatives pages, integration pages, pricing comparisons, use-case pages tied to a specific job title — before touching a top-of-funnel guide. Slower to feel exciting, faster to produce pipeline. And from a standing start it's a six to twelve month build, not a 90-day one.

Telangana's relaxed floor-space rules have made Hyderabad one of India's most vertical construction markets, and Kokapet, Neopolis, Narsingi, Tellapur, Financial District, Bachupally and Kompally each generate their own demand. That demand comes in two very different shapes, and confusing them is why builder websites underperform.

**Project-name queries** — someone searching a specific tower by name — are high-intent and short-lived. They spike at pre-launch, peak around launch, and fade once inventory sells. Ranking for your own project name against 99acres and MagicBricks is winnable in weeks, and it's worth doing because a portal lead costs you money and a direct lead doesn't.

**Locality queries** — flats in Kokapet, gated communities in Tellapur, 3 BHK near Financial District — are durable, far more competitive and owned by the portals. A 6–12 month build, worth funding only if you have a pipeline of projects in that micro-market rather than one.

The practical consequence: a builder's SEO budget should be split by project lifecycle, not evenly across the year. We front-load work into the eight weeks before a launch and let the locality content compound quietly underneath.

callout.title: The RERA detail people forget
callout.body: Every project page needs its TS-RERA registration number visible and consistent across your site, your portal listings and your ads. Mismatches are a compliance problem first and a trust signal problem second — and Google's quality raters are explicitly told to look for exactly this kind of verifiable business information.

sections.h2: Telugu, Urdu and the transliterated middle
body: Hyderabad's language mix is genuinely distinctive: Telugu as the state language, a large Urdu-speaking population, Hindi as a working lingua franca across the old city and the migrant workforce, and English as the default of the corridor.

That doesn't mean four language versions of your site. The useful unit of work isn't translation, it's transliteration: people type Telugu and Urdu phrases in Roman letters far more often than in native script, because that's what the keyboard produces without being configured.

The practical rule: build one strong English page per intent, mine your Search Console export for transliterated variants already landing on it, and fold those phrasings into the copy. Native-script Telugu pages earn their place for mass-market consumer products — a clinic chain, an ed-tech app, a retail brand — and rarely before.
See [English vs regional-language SEO](/compare/english-vs-regional-language-seo) for how we decide when a second language version is worth the maintenance cost, because it always has one.

sections.h2: What the first 90 days look like on a Hyderabad account
body: We take three clients a month, total, across every city — not scarcity marketing, just the only way to carry a guarantee that costs us money when we're wrong. The sequence below doesn't change much by city. What changes is where the budget goes.
numbered: **Week 1 — freeze the baseline.** We pull your trailing 90 days of qualified organic leads from your CRM, agree the definition in writing, and lock the number.

**Weeks 1–2 — technical crawl and the Business Profile.** For local categories, an unclaimed or half-filled Google Business Profile is usually the single largest gap. For pharma and SaaS, it's indexation and site speed.
**Weeks 2–4 — keyword set built from your last ten closed deals**, not from a tool export.
**Weeks 3–10 — publishing on a fixed cadence**, plus fixing pages you already have that never ranked. Refreshing an existing page usually beats writing a new one, and it's cheaper.
**Weeks 6–12 — links and citations.** Slow and boring: industry associations, supplier directories that actually get used, genuine editorial placements.
**Day 90 — the read.** Did your qualified organic leads beat the frozen number? If not, we keep working free until they do.

faqs.q: Is SEO cheaper in Hyderabad than in Bangalore or Mumbai?
faqs.a: Agency rates in Hyderabad tend to sit slightly below Bangalore's, but the bigger saving isn't the rate — it's that you often need fewer months of work to move a local-intent keyword set here, because fewer local competitors are running serious SEO. That advantage disappears entirely if your buyers are outside India.

faqs.q: Do you work with Genome Valley pharma and CRO companies?
faqs.a: Yes, and the work looks different from consumer SEO. Content has to survive internal regulatory and medical review, keyword sets are built from molecule names, dosage forms and certifications rather than tool exports, and success is measured in qualified RFQs, not traffic. Expect three to six months before movement, not four weeks.

faqs.q: Do I need a Telugu version of my website to rank in Hyderabad?
faqs.a: Usually no. Most Telugu and Urdu search in Hyderabad arrives transliterated into Roman script, so folding those phrasings into strong English pages captures the majority of it. A full native-script version earns its maintenance cost when you're selling a mass-market consumer product, not a B2B service.

faqs.q: How fast can a Hyderabad real estate project rank for its own name?
faqs.a: Often within weeks, because you have the strongest possible relevance signal for your own project name and the portals only have a listing page. Locality keywords like flats in Kokapet are a different problem — six to twelve months against 99acres and MagicBricks, and only worth funding if you build there repeatedly.

faqs.q: What does SEO cost in Hyderabad?
faqs.a: Our SEO starts at ₹75,000/mo, with smaller sites from ₹40,000/mo, ex-GST. Across the wider Hyderabad market you'll see quotes from a few thousand rupees a month upward; below roughly ₹25,000 you're buying part-time freelance attention, which can genuinely work for a single-location local business and won't touch a competitive category.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee first-page rankings in Hyderabad?
faqs.a: No, and nobody honestly can — nobody controls Google's index. What we guarantee is movement against your own baseline: your trailing-90-day qualified leads from organic search, frozen on day one. If we haven't beaten that number in 90 days, we keep working free until we do.
